scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix dashboard install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix dashboard run build
scripts.dev: node -e "const {spawn}=require('node:child_process');const opts={stdio:'inherit',shell:process.platform==='win32'};const procs=[spawn('npm',['--prefix','server','run','dev'],opts),spawn('npm',['--prefix','dashboard','run','dev'],opts)];const stop=(code=0)=>{for(const p of procs)if(!p.killed)p.kill();process.exit(code)};process.on('SIGINT',()=>stop(0));process.on('SIGTERM',()=>stop(0));for(const p of procs)p.on('exit',(code)=>stop(code??0));"
